### A Bachata Weekend for International Dancers

#### English-Taught Workshops

Workshops welcome beginners, intermediate and advanced dancers, with three rooms running in parallel during every workshop hour. Teaching is in **English**. [Explore Bachata workshops for every level](https://milanosensualcongress.com/news/bachata-workshop-levels-guide-congress).

#### International Accessibility

Travel with ease with our **dedicated direct shuttles** from Milan Malpensa, Linate, and Bergamo airports directly to the luxury Devero Hotel venue. [Read why Milan is becoming a must-visit Bachata destination](https://milanosensualcongress.com/news/bachata-italy-2026-milan-dance-destination).

#### European Community

Join a diverse community of high-level social dancers from Spain, France, Germany, and Switzerland in a **World-class luxury venue**. Travelling independently? ### Organizers of the Bachata Congress Italy

#### Marco Fracassi

Congress Co-founder & Organizer

@marcoyvaleria — Marco and his dance partner Valeria are international Sensual Bachata artists with a dance school in Arcore, MB. Marco co-founded **Milano Sensual Congress** with Alessandro Slamitz. With a decade of teaching and performance experience, they are directors of the **Gero y Migle Project Performance Show** in Milan, and Marco serves as artistic director for one of the top Latin club in Milan, the UnaMas Club.

#### Alessandro Slamitz (Ale)

Congress Co-founder & Organizer

@aleyxidan — Ale and his dance partner Xidan are international Sensual Bachata artists. They founded [AXcent Dance](https://axcentdance.com), the first Bachata Sensual specialized school in Zurich, established in 2025. They also serve as judges for the International Swiss Championship for Salsa and Bachata. Alessandro co-founded **Milano Sensual Congress** with Marco Fracassi. Ale y Xidan are also the co-organizers of **Bailadoro Dance Weekend**.

### Bachata Congress FAQ

#### Where is the event located?

The entire event takes place at the **New Devero Hotel & Spa** (4 Stars Executive), located in Cavenago di Brianza. It is easily accessible from Milan airports.

#### Can I compete in the Jack & Jill?

Yes! Registration for the International Jack & Jill is open. Entry costs €20, plus the ticket platform’s booking fees, and requires a valid Full Pass or Full Social Pass. [Competition details and registration](https://milanosensualcongress.com/jacknjill).

#### How do I book the hotel?

Book through the official link on our [Hotel page](https://milanosensualcongress.com/hotel), where you can also find room information and booking support.

#### Will there be day socials?

Yes, there are afternoon socials on Saturday and Sunday. See the [Parties page](https://milanosensualcongress.com/parties) for times and pass requirements.

#### Are the Bachata Masterclasses taught in English?

Yes, all our international workshops, masterclasses, and main stage communications at the Milano Sensual Congress are conducted in **English** to accommodate our European and global attendees.

#### Which airport is best for the Milano Sensual Congress?

Milan Bergamo Orio al Serio (BGY) and Milan Linate (LIN) are the closest, but Milan Malpensa (MXP) is also highly convenient. We offer [dedicated direct transport shuttles](https://milanosensualcongress.com/transfer) from all three airports to the hotel.
